author: VANSMITHLAB
title: teamLab
summary: An art studio in Tokyo since 2001. It creates digital environments calculated in real time, extending beyond individual screens and changing with the presence of viewers.

hero_image.alt: A studio table by a tall window holding small jointed figures, framed screens and movement studies, with one person working over them.
hero_image.caption: The body tested against the screen: movement studied as an object before it becomes an environment.
